tools_helpful.evidence: Bootstrap copied 218 source files, rewrote Windows.UI.Xaml->Microsoft.UI.Xaml in 7/13 files, seeded mapping + TODOs (session-log.txt L213-242).

tools_problematic.problem: Scaffolding with the sample's own name (Accelerometer) made the project root namespace equal a WinRT type, which broke the whole build.
tools_problematic.evidence: csproj <RootNamespace>Accelerometer</RootNamespace>; scaffold App/MainWindow/MainPage use 'namespace Accelerometer' while source uses 'namespace SDKTemplate' (session-log.txt L1290,1364,1394).

tool_limitations.limitation: Did not detect/repair the project-namespace vs WinRT-type collision introduced by the scaffold name.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Add a bootstrap guard that renames the scaffold root namespace to a collision-free token when it equals a type referenced in the source.

failed_apis.why_tried: Core API of the sample, referenced by simple name in every scenario page.
failed_apis.root_cause: Project root namespace 'Accelerometer' shadowed the WinRT type, so simple-name references bound to the namespace.
failed_apis.fix: Rename the project root namespace away from the type name (e.g. AccelerometerApp) so the simple name resolves to Windows.Devices.Sensors.Accelerometer.

errors_encountered.error: CS0118 'Accelerometer' is a namespace but is used like a type (x9, Scenario1-5 .xaml.cs)
errors_encountered.root_cause: RootNamespace == project name 'Accelerometer' collides with Windows.Devices.Sensors.Accelerometer.
errors_encountered.fix: Bootstrap now renames the scaffold root namespace to <Name>App when it collides with a source-referenced type.

errors_encountered.error: XamlCompiler WMC9999 internal error (NullReferenceException) in MarkupCompilePass2
errors_encountered.root_cause: Downstream symptom of the same namespace/type collision during XAML codegen.
errors_encountered.fix: Resolved by removing the namespace/type collision at bootstrap.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Agent migrated file-by-file but never ran 'dotnet build' or Validate-UwpMigration.ps1; session ended at TURN 26 still viewing source/assets.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Slow per-file exploration consumed the turn budget before the build/validate loop; the latent namespace collision was never surfaced because no build ran.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Bootstrap-time prevention of the collision (tooling, can't be skipped) so the very first build the next run does is not poisoned by CS0118; SKILL.md already mandates an early build loop (Step 3/4).

missing_tooling.need: Namespace/type collision guard at scaffold/bootstrap time.
missing_tooling.would_have_saved: All 9 CS0118 errors + the WMC9999 XAML crash; the build would have had a chance to succeed.

env_issues.workaround: Hardware-gated; UWP golden shows 'No data'. Not a migration defect (score notes).
